stories.headline: Iran Rejects 45-Day Ceasefire, Submits 10-Point Plan as Trump Tuesday Deadline Looms

key_facts.fact: Iran rejected the 45-day ceasefire proposal and submitted a 10-point plan through Pakistan demanding a permanent end to the war, not a temporary truce
key_facts.excerpt: Iran on Monday rejected a 45-day ceasefire proposal and said it wants a permanent end to the war… Tehran conveyed its 10-point response through Pakistan, a key mediator

key_facts.fact: Iran's 10-point framework includes demands for ending regional conflicts, safe Strait of Hormuz passage, reconstruction of war-affected areas, and lifting international sanctions
key_facts.excerpt: The response outlines Iran's demands, including ending regional conflicts, establishing safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, reconstructing war-affected areas, and lifting international sanctions

key_facts.fact: Trump acknowledged Iran's proposal as 'a significant step' but said 'it's not good enough' and threatened to destroy every bridge and power plant in Iran by Tuesday midnight
key_facts.excerpt: 'Every bridge in Iran will be decimated' by midnight on Tuesday, Trump told reporters. 'Every power plant in Iran will be out of business, burning, exploding and never to be used again.'

key_facts.fact: Iran's chief negotiator said Iran no longer trusts the Trump administration after the US bombed the Republic twice during previous rounds of talks
key_facts.excerpt: 'We only accept an end of the war with guarantees that we won't be attacked again,' Mojtaba Ferdousi Pour, head of Iran's diplomatic mission in Cairo, told The Associated Press

key_facts.fact: Defense Secretary Hegseth said Monday would see the 'largest volume of strikes since day one' with even more the next day
key_facts.excerpt: 'Today will be the largest volume of strikes since day one,' Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said. 'Tomorrow, even more than today.'

key_facts.fact: The UN warned any attack on civilian infrastructure is a clear violation of international law; a US-Israeli projectile struck a synagogue in Tehran
key_facts.excerpt: 'Any attack on civilian infrastructure is a violation of international law and a very clear one,' United Nations spokesperson Stephane Dujarric later told journalists

key_facts.fact: A regional official involved in talks said diplomatic efforts had not collapsed: 'We are still talking to both sides'
key_facts.excerpt: A regional official involved in talks said efforts had not collapsed. 'We are still talking to both sides,' he said, speaking on condition of anonymity

stories.headline: Artemis II Completes Historic Lunar Flyby, Shatters Apollo 13 Distance Record by 4,101 Miles

key_facts.fact: Orion spacecraft surpassed the Apollo 13 distance record of 248,655 miles at 17:56 UTC on April 6, reaching a maximum distance of 252,756 miles (406,771 km) from Earth
key_facts.excerpt: At 17:56 UTC on Monday 6 April 2026, the Orion spacecraft Integrity surpassed the milestone of 400,171 kilometers set by Apollo 13. NASA says the mission reached its maximum distance from Earth at 23:02 UTC: 406,771 kilometers

key_facts.fact: The crew made closest approach to the Moon at 4,067 miles above the lunar surface and experienced a 40-minute communications blackout behind the far side
key_facts.excerpt: A total solar eclipse greeted the three Americans and one Canadian as the moon temporarily blocked the sun from their perspective. Mercury, Venus, Mars and Saturn nodded at them from the black void.

key_facts.fact: The crew witnessed a total solar eclipse as the Moon blocked the Sun, and saw the landing sites of Apollo 12 and 14 during their flyby
key_facts.excerpt: The landing sites of Apollo 12 and 14 also were visible, poignant reminders of NASA's first age of exploration more than half a century ago.

key_facts.fact: Apollo 13 commander Jim Lovell's recorded farewell message was beamed to the crew; Lovell had died last August, two months after the recording
key_facts.excerpt: Apollo 13 commander Jim Lovell wished the crew well in a recording made two months before his death last August. 'Welcome to my old neighborhood,' said Lovell

key_facts.fact: Trump congratulated the crew in a live link-up, calling it 'really big stuff' while the White House had proposed cutting NASA's budget by $5.6 billion just days earlier
key_facts.excerpt: Trump congratulated the crew for 'making history'… Last week, the White House released a proposed budget for Nasa that, if approved by Congress, would see its budget slashed by $5.6 billion.

key_facts.fact: The crew—Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Jeremy Hansen—are now on a return path to Earth with splashdown set for Friday
key_facts.excerpt: They're now on a path back toward Earth with a splashdown return set for Friday.

stories.headline: Samsung Posts Record Q1 Operating Profit of 57.2 Trillion Won ($38B), Up 755% YoY

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics reported preliminary Q1 operating profit of 57.2 trillion won ($38B), surging 755% from 6.61 trillion won a year earlier
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics Co. on Tuesday estimated its first-quarter operating profit to have surpassed 50 trillion won for the first time… 57.2 trillion won for the January-March period, surging from 6.61 trillion won a year earlier

key_facts.fact: Quarterly revenue hit 133 trillion won, up 68.1% YoY, exceeding 100 trillion won for the first time ever; Q1 operating profit alone exceeded full-year 2025 earnings of 43.6 trillion won
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue rose 68.1 percent on-year to 133 trillion won in the first quarter, exceeding 100 trillion won for the first time ever… Samsung Electronics' operating profit for all of 2025 was 43.6 trillion won

key_facts.fact: Results crushed market expectations: operating profit was 36.7% above the average analyst estimate, driven by surging AI memory chip demand
key_facts.excerpt: The operating profit was 36.7 percent higher than the average estimate, according to a survey by Yonhap Infomax

key_facts.fact: DRAM contract prices rose 90-95% in Q1 and are projected to climb another 60% in Q2, with some forecasts pointing to 250% annual price surge
key_facts.excerpt: According to market tracker TrendForce, DRAM prices rose 90-95 percent in the first quarter from the previous quarter and are projected to climb another 60 percent in the second quarter

key_facts.fact: Analysts project Samsung could surpass Nvidia next year in annual operating profit; KB Securities raised annual forecast to 327 trillion won for 2026
key_facts.excerpt: The surge in earnings has propelled Samsung into the global top five in quarterly operating profit, with some analysts saying the company could surpass Nvidia next year to claim the top spot worldwide

stories.headline: Anthropic Revenue Crosses $30B Run Rate, Secures 3.5GW TPU Capacity From Google and Broadcom

key_facts.fact: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate surpassed $30 billion, up from approximately $9 billion at the end of 2025, tripling in under four months
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic seemingly tries to reassure markets about its financial affairs by revealing that 'Our run-rate revenue has now surpassed $30 billion—up from approximately $9 billion at the end of 2025.'

key_facts.fact: Over 1,000 enterprise customers are each spending more than $1 million annually on Claude, doubling from 500+ in less than two months since February
key_facts.excerpt: 'When we announced our Series G fundraising in February, we shared that over 500 business customers were each spending over $1 million on an annualized basis. Today that number exceeds 1,000, doubling in less than two months'

key_facts.fact: Anthropic signed a deal to access approximately 3.5 gigawatts of next-generation TPU-based AI compute capacity through Broadcom and Google, starting in 2027
key_facts.excerpt: The expansion will provide Anthropic with multiple gigawatts of TPU capacity, expected to come online starting in 2027

key_facts.fact: Broadcom signed a long-term agreement with Google to develop and supply future generations of TPUs and networking components for AI racks through 2031
key_facts.excerpt: A 'Long Term Agreement for Broadcom to develop and supply custom Tensor Processing Units for Google's future generations of TPUs'… 'Supply Assurance Agreement… through up to 2031'

key_facts.fact: Broadcom's regulatory filing noted that the expanded deployment is 'dependent on Anthropic's continued commercial success,' flagging potential risk
key_facts.excerpt: The consumption of such expanded AI compute capacity by Anthropic is dependent on Anthropic's continued commercial success

key_facts.fact: At $30B ARR, Anthropic appears to have surpassed OpenAI's reported $25B ARR, making it the largest AI model provider by revenue run rate
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI was reportedly on a roughly $10 billion annualized revenue pace in mid-2025. If Anthropic's numbers hold and continue climbing, it suggests the market for frontier AI models is not a winner-take-all scenario

stories.headline: SpaceX Plans $75B IPO at Up to $1.75T Valuation With Unprecedented Retail Investor Push

key_facts.fact: SpaceX plans to raise $75 billion in the largest IPO ever, targeting a valuation of up to $1.75 trillion, with roadshow launching the week of June 8
key_facts.excerpt: The rocket maker seeks to raise $75 billion, valuing SpaceX at as much as $1.75 trillion… plans to launch its roadshow the week of June 8

key_facts.fact: CFO Bret Johnsen told the full 21-bank syndicate that 'retail is going to be a critical part of this and a bigger part than any IPO in history'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Retail is going to be a critical part of this and a bigger part than any IPO in history,' Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen said during the virtual meeting

key_facts.fact: SpaceX will host 1,500 retail investors at a major event on June 11, with retail investors in the US, UK, EU, Australia, Canada, Japan, and Korea eligible to participate
key_facts.excerpt: On June 11, SpaceX plans to host 1,500 retail investors at what the people described as a major investor event. In addition to the U.S., everyday retail investors in the UK, EU, Australia, Canada, Japan and Korea would have the opportunity

key_facts.fact: Musk previously sought to set aside up to 30% of shares for retail investors, compared with 5-10% for most IPOs; the IPO prospectus is planned for late May
key_facts.excerpt: Musk wanted to set aside up to 30% of the company's shares for smaller investors, compared with 5% to 10% for most companies. The company plans to make its IPO prospectus public in late May

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Citigroup, JPMorgan, and Goldman Sachs are leading the deal with 16 other banks in smaller roles
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, Citigroup, JP Morgan and Goldman Sachs are leading the deal as active bookrunners, with 16 other banks in smaller roles

key_facts.fact: The $1.75T target is a significant step up from the $1.25T combined valuation set when SpaceX merged with Musk's AI startup xAI in February
key_facts.excerpt: The $1.75tn target represents a significant step up from the $1.25 trillion combined valuation set when SpaceX merged with Musk's artificial intelligence startup xAI in Feb

stories.headline: Israel Deepens Lebanon Offensive With Renewed Strikes Across Country, 15+ Killed in One Day

key_facts.fact: Israeli forces launched renewed airstrikes across Lebanon on Sunday April 6, hitting the south and Beirut's outskirts, killing at least 15 people in a single day
key_facts.excerpt: Israeli strikes in Lebanon on Sunday killed at least 15 people, a day after Israel threatened to hit Lebanon's main border crossing with Syria, forcing it to close

key_facts.fact: A strike in the Christian area of Ain Saadeh east of Beirut killed three people including Pierre Moawad, a member of the anti-Hezbollah Lebanese Forces party, and his wife
key_facts.excerpt: Two US-made GBU-39 bombs crashed through the roof of the building directly facing his balcony, killing three people… Pierre Moawad, a member of the anti-Hezbollah, Christian party the Lebanese Forces, his wife, Flavia, and a visiting friend

key_facts.fact: A strike in Beirut's Jnah neighbourhood landed about 100 meters from the Rafik Hariri University Hospital, Lebanon's largest public facility, killing 5 and wounding 52
key_facts.excerpt: One of Israel's strikes in Beirut Sunday killed at least five people and wounded 52 in the Jnah neighbourhood

key_facts.fact: Since March 2, Israeli attacks on Lebanon have killed more than 1,500 people including 130 children and displaced over 1.2 million
key_facts.excerpt: Overall, Israeli attacks have killed some 1,500 people, including 130 children, in Lebanon, while more than 1.2 million have been forced from their homes

key_facts.fact: Israeli military chief Lt Gen Eyal Zamir visited troops in southern Lebanon and pledged to intensify strikes against Hezbollah
key_facts.excerpt: Israeli military chief Lieutenant General Eyal Zamir visited troops in southern Lebanon on Sunday and pledged to intensify strikes against Hezbollah

stories.headline: Kalshi Wins Landmark Third Circuit Appeal: Federal Law Preempts State Gambling Regulation

key_facts.fact: The Third Circuit Court of Appeals ruled 2-1 that New Jersey cannot bring enforcement action against Kalshi, finding the federal Commodity Exchange Act preempts state gambling laws
key_facts.excerpt: A Third Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled in a 2-1 vote that the state could not bring an enforcement action against Kalshi because the company's products are subject to the federal Commodity Exchange Act

key_facts.fact: The court held that Kalshi's self-certified sports-related event contracts are 'presumptively approved' because the CFTC has not found them contrary to the public interest
key_facts.excerpt: 'Kalshi self-certified compliance with the applicable laws and regulations, so those event contracts were presumptively approved under federal law … To date, the CFTC has not determined that Kalshi's sports-related event contracts are contrary to the public interest'

key_facts.fact: The dissenting judge argued the products 'are sports gambling,' citing NFL game outcome bets, point spreads, and player prop contracts available on the platform
key_facts.excerpt: Circuit Judge Jane Roth, who penned a dissent, said the New Jersey state rules did not 'undermine the congressional objectives'… and the actual products available on Kalshi's platform 'are sports gambling'

key_facts.fact: Sports-related event contracts represent approximately 85% of Kalshi's business; the ruling aligns with earlier decisions in Nevada and Tennessee but conflicts with Maryland and Massachusetts rulings
key_facts.excerpt: The Third Circuit's decision aligns with earlier rulings in Nevada and Tennessee, where courts temporarily blocked state regulators… the outcome contrasts with decisions in Maryland and Massachusetts, where courts have ruled in favor of state authority

key_facts.fact: Kalshi still faces pending legal challenges in Ohio, Connecticut, and New York, with the circuit split likely heading toward Supreme Court review
key_facts.excerpt: Kalshi continues to face legal challenges in multiple jurisdictions, including Ohio, Connecticut, and New York, where preliminary injunction motions are still pending
